spec.situation_desc: transferred money to someone pretending to be from the bank

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thistle Bank, Jordan speaking. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Hi, I’m Niamh Ndlovu. I transferred money to someone pretending to be from your bank, and I’m really unhappy with how this has been handled.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’ll need to verify you first. What’s your full name and date of birth, please?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: And the first line of your address?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thanks. I’m sorry you’ve had this experience. Before we get into it, I’ll log this as a complaint. We’ll get the money returned to you, so that should be sorted.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: You can guarantee that? I was told it might not be straightforward.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Yes, it’ll be returned. What was the transfer amount and when did you send it?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: It was £2,400 on Monday, to someone who called saying they were from the fraud team.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Right. I’ll take ownership of this and send it to our fraud complaints team today. I’ll call you with an update by 4 pm tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: And when will I get a proper answer about the complaint?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: You’ll get a full written response within 15 business days. The fraud complaints team will review what happened, and I’ll call you tomorrow by 4 pm with an update.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Okay. Is there anything else I need to do?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: No. So, I’ve logged the complaint, the team will review the transfer, and I’ll call by 4 pm tomorrow; the full written response will be within 15 business days. Does that make sense?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Good. That’s all for now. Goodbye.
